Hi, everyone!

Today I made cute Shiba character meringue cookies. Character meringue cookies always make me happy.

I wish you all try to make them.

Thank you for watching my video! Please Like and Subscribe if you liked my video :) 

 



- Ingredients

White 107g(Around 3 big eggs), Sugar 149g(White x 1.4 = sugar)
Sugar powder 20g
Lemon juice 2g
Colorings - Golden yellow(ChefMaster), Buckeye brown(ChefMaster), Coal black(ChefMaster)
Wood sticks

 

- Piping bags

Wilton piping tip # 1A, # 7, # 3, piping bags

(It was #3 piping tip, not #2 at 2:16)

 


- Oven

(Lacuzin Signature Mini-oven LCZ1402)

Preheat at 80 Celsius degrees for 15 mins

Heat at 70 Celsius degrees for 4 hrs

 


- Whipping machine

Offel Hand Mixer (White OFM - 309)

Hello, guys
Long time no see
I made some flower bear meringue pops.
Colorful flowers look so cute with bears' faces in them.
I've decreased the amount of sugar powder since it's been pretty dry, but I guess I should increase the amount again since it's getting moist again.
Thank you for coming to watch my video!
If you liked my video, please Like and Subscribe my channel 



Ingredients
105g White(Around 3 big eggs), 147g Sugar(White x 1.4 = Sugar)
10g Sugar Powder
2g Lemon Juice
Paper straw 

Colorings - Redred(ChefMaster), Violet(ChefMaster), Golden Yellow(ChefMaster), Coal Black(ChefMaster)

Piping bags
Wilton Piping Tip # 1A, # 2D, # 10, piping bags

Oven
(Lacuzin Signature Mini-oven LCZ1402)
Preheat at 80 Celsius degrees for 15 mins
Heat at 70 Celsius degrees for 4 hrs

Whipping machine

Thank you for watching my video today as well! Please subscribe and like if you liked my video.

#Meringue #머랭쿠키시리얼 #미니오븐베이킹 #미니오븐머랭쿠키 #후루트링 


 [english subtitl]

💌E-mail : cokp0908@gmail.com
📱Instagram : Meringue__s (https://instagram.com/meringue__s)


안녕하세요 여러분 이번에는 시리얼 머랭 쿠키를 만들어보았는데요! 알록달록 너무 예쁘고 떠먹는 요구르트랑 조합이 최고였답니다 ☺️
미니오븐이라 한판에 많은 양이 나오지는 못하지만 머랭은 미니오븐 기준 2-3판 넘게 만들 수 있는 양이었습니다! 
대량생산해서 습기 제거제랑 보관하고 먹고 싶을 때 먹어도 좋을 것 같다는 생각이 들었어요 🤔
여러분들도 영상 보시고 꼭 한번 만들어보세요 ♥️👏

영상이 마음에 드셨다면 구독과 좋아요 부탁드립니다 😊🙏 


재료

흰자104g(계란특란3개분량) 설탕 145g(흰자 x 1.4 = 설탕 )
슈가파우더 20g
레몬즙 2g
식용색소 - 네온 브라이트 베이커스로즈(쉐프마스터),오렌지(윌튼),골덴 옐로우(윌튼),모스그린(윌튼),네온 브라이트 블루(쉐프마스터)


깍지사용X


오븐

80도 예열 70도 30분 (라쿠진 시그니처 미니오븐 LCZ1402)



BGM

달담뮤직 DalDameowsic
#26 벚꽃 
https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=qiaec5VILfg


🎵Music provided by 브금대통령
🎵Track : 음악시간 - https://youtu.be/gJk4hr3r26E



❌ 영상무단도용,불펌 금지 ❌




Hello everyone, this time I made cereal meringue cookies! It was so pretty and the combination with yogurt was the best 
I am using a mini oven, so I couldn't make a lot at one time, but it was enough to make more than around 2-3 boards of meringue!
I thought that it would be good to mass-produce it and store it with a dehumidifier and eat it when you want to eat it 
Everyone, please watch the video and try to make it by yourselves too! 

If you liked the video, please like the video and subscribe 

Ingredients

Egg white 104g (Around 3 big size eggs), Sugar 145g (Egg white x 1.4 = Sugar)
Sugar powder 20g
Lemon juice 2g
Food colorings - Neon Bright Bakers Rose (Chef Master), Orange (Wilton), Golden Yellow (Wilton), Moss Green (Wilton), Neon Bright Blue (Chef Master)

Didn't use piping tips

Oven
Warm up at 80 degrees
30 min at 70 degrees
(Lacuzin Signature mini oven LCZ1402) 

BGM
DalDameowsic
#26 Cherry Blossom 
https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=qiaec5VILfg

Artist: Today's diary 
Title: Pluffy hotcake 
Link : https://youtu.be/Ar7snmT6X68 
 
No unauthorized use without permission

안녕하세요 이번에는 딸기 머랭팝을 만들어봤어요!
캐릭터만 만들다가 머랭팝에 처음 도전해봤는데 너무 재밌었어요 🥺 디자인 구상해서 다른 머랭팝들도 빨리 만들고 싶네요👏 
여러분들도 영상보시고 귀여운 머랭팝 만들어보세요🥰♥️



재료

흰자109g(계란특란3개분량) 설탕 152g(흰자 x 1.4 = 설탕 )
슈가파우더 20g
레몬즙 2g
식용색소 - 레드레드(윌튼),버크아이브라운(쉐프마스터),모스그린(윌튼)
아라잔스프링클 스트로베리 필드 딸기밭에서 폴린러브 simple Sucre 8oz
종이빨대


깍지
